_comment: Kokoro-82M's ONNX I/O signature, recorded from the real model via rust/tests/mini_model_pact.rs. Both the committed mini and the real model must match it: the mini on every PR, the real one weekly in mini-model-pact.yml. Re-record only when the upstream model genuinely changes — see the workflow header.
_scope: Structural signature only — tensor names, dtypes and ranks. Opset, initializers, node count and external-data layout are deliberately NOT compared: the real model is opset 20 with 554 initializers and 2464 nodes, the mini opset 17 with 0 and 22. This is the contract kesha's code depends on, not a fingerprint of the weights.
